title: 5 Saiyans We’re Dying to See Go Super Saiyan 3 in Dragon Ball (#1 Is Unimaginable)
content: Dragon Ball serves as the foundational series that started the trend of transformations as a means of character growth. It began with Goku unlocking the transformation dubbed Super Saiyan during his fight against Frieza, which redefined the Saiyans’ strength.

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Unveils Teaser Visual, Trailer
content: The previously announced Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 unveiled a teaser visual and trailer on Thursday. Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The release date is yet to be revealed.

title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Amara 's Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) light novel revealed additional cast, a second key visual (pictured), and promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS NTV, and Yomiuri TV in July 2026.
